DI_should_use_ordered_court_position_revoke = {
    switch = {
        trigger = scope:court_position_type
        court_position_type:bloodrider_court_position = {
            any_court_position_holder = {
                type = bloodrider_court_position
                count >= 2
            }
        }
        court_position_type:bodyguard_court_position = {
            any_court_position_holder = {
                type = bodyguard_court_position
                count >= 2
            }
        }
        court_position_type:court_artificer_court_position = {
            any_court_position_holder = {
                type = court_artificer_court_position
                count >= 3
            }
        }
        court_position_type:garuda_court_position = {
            any_court_position_holder = {
                type = garuda_court_position
                count >= 2
            }
        }
        court_position_type:justiciar_court_position = {
            any_court_position_holder = {
                type = justiciar_court_position
                count >= 2
            }
        }
        court_position_type:lady_in_waiting_court_position = {
            any_court_position_holder = {
                type = lady_in_waiting_court_position
                count >= 2
            }
        }
        fallback = { always = no }
    }
}


DI_court_position_spawn_enabled = {
    switch = {
        trigger = scope:court_position_type
        court_position_type:admiral_court_position = {
            scope:target = {
                any_sub_realm_county = {
                    is_coastal_county = yes
                }
            }
        }
        court_position_type:akolouthos_court_position = { always = no }
        court_position_type:antiquarian_court_position = {
            scope:target = {
                OR = {
                    is_landed_or_landless_administrative = yes
                    government_has_flag = government_is_nomadic
                }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = {
                        is_ai = yes
                    }
                    has_any_artifact = yes
                }
            }
        }
        court_position_type:archer_captain_camp_officer = {
            scope:target = {
                custom_tooltip = {
                    text = landless_government_tt
                    government_has_flag = government_is_landless_adventurer
                }
                custom_tooltip = {
                    text = archer_captain_captain_camp_officer_parameter_tt
                    domicile ?= {
                        has_domicile_parameter = camp_unlocks_archer_captain_officer
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        court_position_type:armorer_camp_officer = {
            scope:target = {
                custom_tooltip = {
                    text = landless_government_tt
                    government_has_flag = government_is_landless_adventurer
                }
                custom_tooltip = {
                    text = armorer_camp_officer_parameter_tt

                        has_domicile_parameter = camp_unlocks_armorer_officer

                }
            }
